summary: Returns the interval between two dates in a chosen unit.
description: The result is the first date minus the second, so it is negative when the second is later. Whole units are reported by default; pass `float` to get the fraction as well.

Milliseconds, seconds, minutes and hours are fixed lengths and are divided out exactly. Days, months and years are counted as whole elapsed units, which is why two hours across midnight is `0` days and not `1`.

params.left: The date the interval is measured from.
params.float: Keep the fractional part instead of truncating. Fixed-length units only.

returns: the interval, negative when the second date is later.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: an argument is not a valid `Date`, or the unit is unknown.
